description: Secure-by-default firewall for Windows built on Windows Firewall. Developer: Károly Pados.
pre_uninstall: throw "TinyWall's cleanup executable was not found at $tinyWallExe. Scoop uninstall was aborted to avoid leaving its service and firewall filters behind."
throw "TinyWall cleanup was cancelled or could not start. Scoop uninstall was aborted. $($_.Exception.Message)"
throw "TinyWall cleanup failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Scoop uninstall was aborted."
throw 'TinyWall service is still registered. Scoop uninstall was aborted.'
throw 'TinyWall Controller scheduled task still exists. Scoop uninstall was aborted.'
throw 'TinyWall original Hosts file was not restored. Scoop uninstall was aborted.'
notes: On first launch, TinyWall may request administrator approval to register its Windows service and configure the scheduled task that starts the tray controller.
Uninstalling through Scoop runs TinyWall's own cleanup with administrator approval. If cleanup is cancelled or incomplete, Scoop keeps the application files.
TinyWall blocks most communication by default. Use the tray menu's whitelist options to allow required applications; do not install or first-run it over a remote connection.
